description: Form 8582 instructions (2025), Dispositions Example 2: entire interest in an oil and gas limited partnership sold for a $2,000 gain; $3,330 current-year Schedule E loss and $1,115 prior-year unallowed loss. 'Because you have an overall loss of $2,445 ... none of the amounts are entered on Form 8582. You enter the net loss plus the prior-year unallowed loss ($3,330 + $1,115 = $4,445) on Schedule E'. AGI = 40,000 + 2,000 − 4,445 = $37,555.
